summary: Shell plc filed a Form 6-K announcing routine board committee changes. Ann Godbehere will step down as Chair and member of the Audit and Risk Committee effective August 1, 2026, having served over eight years; Holly Keller Koeppel, a Non-executive Director and ARC member, will assume the Chair role. This is an ordinary governance notification under UKLR 6.4.6R and does not constitute a special-situation event, forced management departure, or strategic transaction. The filing is incorporated by reference into existing registration statements. No deal terms, pricing, or strategic actions are disclosed; no special-situation category applies. Watch for no further developments as this is solely a routine committee transition.
